name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) Crispy Skin-On Seasoned Fries (Plain Ketchup)
whyItWorks: Crispy skin-on russet potato fries. Salted and crunchy outside with soft interior potato starch that absorbs easily in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Seasoned Fries plain with ketchup (skip the loaded Rendezvous cheese/pork topping during sensitive phases).
watchOuts: Frying oil can be rich during active digestive flareups
